issues.title_en: Nairobi court approves extradition of three Kenyans to the U.S. over cybercrime charges
issues.summary: The three suspects are wanted by American authorities to face charges concerning conspiracy to commit computer intrusions, conspiracy to commit wire fraud, aggravated identity theft, as well as aiding and abetting under United States federal law.
